description: A special member named after the class, with no return type, that runs when an object is created with new.
A reference to the current object, used to tell a field apart from a parameter with the same name.
Hiding fields behind private and exposing methods so a class can keep its objects valid.
A field or method that belongs to the class itself and exists once, not once per object.
A pair of methods that must agree: objects that are equal must return the same hash code.
A compact class for plain data whose constructor, accessors, toString, equals and hashCode are generated.
